title: Redirect an outputer's source document in an OutJob
summary: Opens an .OutJob as IWSM_OutputJobDocument, finds an outputer by name and points it at another source document with IOutputer.DM_SetDocumentPath, then marks the job modified and optionally saves it.
phrasings: change the data source of an output
point a schematic print at another sheet
set the document path of an OutJob output
list outputs of an output job with their documents

commands.name: ChangeOutputJobFile
commands.description: Open the OutJob, set the source document of every outputer whose DM_ViewName equals Outputer, mark the job modified, optionally save; report each document path before and after

commands.name: ListOutputJobOutputers
commands.description: List the OutJob's outputers: DM_ViewName, DM_GeneratorName, DM_GetDocumentKind, DM_GetDocumentPath
